title: E-GRV-0069: no curvature from shared information around a lone vibe on the quantum state of the working vacuum, fail...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0069 in the gravity arena: no curvature from shared information around a lone vibe on the quantum state of the working vacuum, fail on K1 and K2: the vacuum with the coin (side 8, 17 starts, 16 beats) is one term at every beat, so its neighboring husk columns share exactly 0 bits and there is no background geometry to curve; a lone love, in superposition over 16 to 130 terms, correlates only the 4 to 8 columns of its own line, and the shell mean of neighbor information around it falls from 4.2e-2 at r = 0 to 5.9e-3 (2.8 errors), 1.8e-3, 6.3e-4 and 2.2e-4 at r = 1 to 4 and to 0 from r = 5, a log slope of -2.31 that is one line diluted over growing shells, not 1/r; charge blind (love and fear agree within errors at every r), norm exact.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
